title: Data Science Trainer
description:
Job Summery:

A Data Science Trainer is responsible for teaching various modules of Data Science as per the curriculum. They deliver training sessions, prepare learning materials, and assess the progress of learners. The role demands strong expertise in data analytics, programming, machine learning, deep learning, and emerging AI technologies. A Data Science Trainer must be able to simplify complex technical concepts, demonstrate practical applications, and communicate effectively. They play a key rolein shaping learners into skilled data professionals who can work with real-world datasets and industry-relevant tools.

Roles & Responsibilities:

* Conducting classroom or online lectures on Data Science, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, AI, SQL, Python, and related technologies.
* Assigning and evaluating practical exercises, projects, and data-driven case studies.
* Guiding students one-on-one with coding support, doubt-solving, and project mentoring.
* Ensuring that the course curriculum is updated, practical, and aligned with current industry needs.
* Collaborating with other trainers and content developers to create and improve training materials.
* Maintaining accurate records of student performance, attendance, and progress reports.
* Creating a positive, engaging, and hands-on learning environment for students.
* Participating in faculty meetings, workshops, and continuous professional development activities.
* Keeping up-to-date with the latest advancements in Data Science tools, frameworks, and technologies.

Email: Sachin.prasad@itvedant.com  
Contact : 8655301282

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
